site.metaTitle: Bibi – the app for your organisation's daily operation
site.metaDescription: Bibi is an app that helps organisations handle their daily operation: bookings, rooms, food and drink, activities and payments in one place.
site.heading: The app that helps your organisation run its daily operation
site.lead: Bibi helps organisations handle their daily operation, from the first customer request to the finished event. Bookings, rooms, food and drink, activities and payments live in one place, and the customer pays through a link.

orders.title: Packages
orders.body: Create an order for a smaller meeting without a quote. The customer pays by card or on invoice through a link and never has to use the app.

needs.title: Needs as counts
needs.body: Allergens and other needs are counted against your own lists and compiled automatically. No personal data about guests.

runSheets.title: Run sheets that reach the right person
runSheets.body: Versioned run sheets, such as the kitchen order, go to the person responsible and can be exported as json, pdf and csv.

setup.title: Your own setup
setup.body: You decide the types, fields, lists, statuses and responsibilities. Access follows roles that you fine-tune per person.
